    • extractWidgetContent

      public void extractWidgetContent(@Nonnull net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor graphics, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTicks)
      Description copied from class: Panel
      Extracts the render state of the panel itself. This is called after the child widgets have been extracted. In contrast to Panel.extractChildren(GuiGraphicsExtractor, int, int, float), the pose is not translated here and the given mouse position is not relative to this panel.
